name: album-art
title: Album Artwork
summary: Adds thumbnails next to albums and playlists.
description: Shows the album cover at the left of each album and each playlist in the lists of the iPod.
details: Each album in a list shows a small picture of its cover. The patch makes the picture from the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod.
If you write the thumbnail file in iPodFirm, its pictures come first. The patch makes the pictures that the file does not have.
After a sync, the patch makes all album pictures one time and keeps them in a file on the iPod. Then the scroll reads nothing from the disk.
Each playlist shows a custom image, or the covers of its first four albums. The patch makes this collage on the iPod. On-The-Go also gets a collage.
requires: Albums: the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod. No other file and no step in iPodFirm is necessary. The thumbnail file of iPodFirm is optional for albums.
Playlists: no file is necessary for the collage of the albums. A custom playlist image needs the thumbnail file. Use the Thumbnails section below to write it.
notes: The patch reads iPod_Control/Artwork/ArtworkDB and the 100 × 100 images in F1028_N.ithmb.
The patch writes the album pictures to the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmAlbumCache. A sync that changes the artwork or the albums makes the file not valid. Then the patch makes it again.

iPodFirm writes the playlist thumbnails to the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmAlbumArt on the iPod. A playlist in that file uses the picture of the file. Else the patch makes the collage of the first four different albums of the playlist.
While the wheel moves, a row whose cover is not in memory shows a grey square. The cover shows when the wheel stops.
The patch loads the covers in the background while an album list shows and the wheel does not move.

The order for an album: the thumbnail file of iPodFirm, then the file of the patch, then the artwork. If you change a cover in iTunes, write the thumbnail file again. Else the old cover in the file comes first.
Version 3.1 is a measurement build. It writes the times of its parts to the file iPod_Control/iTunes/iPodFirmAlbumArtStats. The write can stop the scroll for a short time.
